signature.text:
{P : Type} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup P] →
    [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ P] →
      {s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData (P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)} →
        {α : ℝ} →
          {d : ℕ → NavierStokes.PrimaryODE.FrameData (P × ℝ)} →
            {t : ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData P NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space} →
              {harmonic : ℤ} →
                {g : ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry} →
                  {copy : ℕ → NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency} →
                    {L : ℕ → ℝ} →
                      {W : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} →
                        (interval : ℕ → Set ℝ) →
                          (∀ (n : ℕ), IsOpen (interval n)) →
                            (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < L n) →
                              (∀ (n : ℕ), Set.Icc 0 (L n) ⊆ interval n) →
                                (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                    NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Inputs (d n) (t n) harmonic (g n) (copy n) s.domain 0
                                      (L n)) →
                                  (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                        ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d n) (g n) (copy n)).coefficient
                                          harmonic)
                                        (s.domain ×ˢ interval n)) →
                                    (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                          ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d n) (g n) (copy n)).forcing
                                            (NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copySource (t n).source (g n) (copy n)))
                                          (s.domain ×ˢ interval n)) →
                                      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 2),
                                          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                            (NavierStokes.PrimaryPulseBounds.synthesisColumn
                                              (NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d n) (g n) (copy n)) i)
                                            (s.domain ×ˢ interval n)) →
                                        (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                            ∀ p ∈ s.domain, ((g n).coordinates (copy n) p.2).2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (L n)) →
                                          (rate : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) →
                                            (∀ (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ), 0 < W n v) →
                                              (∀ (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ), HasDerivAt (W n) (rate n v * W n v) v) →
                                                (errorRate : ℕ → ℝ) →
                                                  (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ errorRate n) →
                                                    (constant : ℝ) →
                                                      1 ≤ constant →
                                                        (coordinate_power : ℕ) →
                                                          (∀ (n : ℕ), L n ≤ constant * s.slow n) →
                                                            (∀ (n : ℕ), Real.exp (errorRate n * L n) ≤ constant) →
                                                              (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                                  NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.argumentCost (g n) ≤
                                                                    constant * s.slow n ^ coordinate_power) →
                                                                (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                                    ∀ p ∈ s.domain,
                                                                      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 (L n),
                                                                        ∀ (x : NavierStokes.PrimaryODE.State),
                                                                          inner ℝ x
                                                                              (((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame
                                                                                      (d n) (g n) (copy n)).coefficient
                                                                                  harmonic (p, v))
                                                                                x) ≤
                                                                            (rate n v + errorRate n) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) →
                                                                  (∀ (N : ℕ),
                                                                      ∃ (C : ℝ),
                                                                        0 ≤ C ∧
                                                                          ∃ (m : ℕ),
                                                                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                                              ∀ p ∈ s.domain,
                                                                                ∀ j ≤ N,
                                                                                  ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 (L n),
                                                                                    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
                                                                                            ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame
                                                                                                  (d n) (g n)
                                                                                                  (copy n)).coefficient
                                                                                              harmonic)
                                                                                            (p, v)‖ ≤
                                                                                        C * s.growth n p ^ m ∧
                                                                                      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
                                                                                              ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame
                                                                                                    (d n) (g n)
                                                                                                    (copy n)).forcing
                                                                                                ⋯)
                                                                                              (p, v)‖ ≤
                                                                                          ⋯ * C * ⋯ ^ m * W n v ∧
                                                                                        ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                                                                                          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
                                                                                                (NavierStokes.PrimaryPulseBounds.synthesisColumn
                                                                                                  (NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame
                                                                                                    (d n) (g n)
                                                                                                    (copy n))
                                                                                                  i)
                                                                                                (p, v)‖ ≤
                                                                                            C * ⋯ ^ m) →
                                                                    NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.ModalCopyControl s
                                                                      α d t harmonic g copy L W
